# Changelog Entry

An entry produced under this contract is a single Markdown list item.

- It starts with one of the labels `Added`, `Changed`, `Fixed`, or `Removed`,
  followed by a colon.
- It describes the resulting change in one sentence, present tense.
- It never references the workflow that produced the change.
